verdicts.evidence: At e3a1ca7, resolveFeature used if-chains that fell through to Metered. Commit 7203fe45c replaced them with an exhaustive switch whose default does `const unhandled: never` (entitlements.service.ts). LucieFaire noted it was addressed, and moisses89 confirmed.

At e3a1ca7, feature.entity.ts had `export type FeatureKey = string`. It is now `(typeof FEATURE_KEYS)[number]` with an `isFeatureKey` guard, and moisses89 replied "✅ Closed. FeatureKey is the union now".

At e3a1ca7, the local `function materializedSubscription(` sat at entitlements.service.integration.spec.ts:368. It is gone at HEAD, where only materializedSubscriptionBuilder is used. moisses89 said all of LucieFaire's comments were applied in 1f4c4b0a3.

Commit 1f4c4b0a3 replaced the hand-rolled adminQuery CREATE/DROP DATABASE helper with TestDbFactory.createTestDatabase/destroyTestDatabase. The change is in both entitlements.controller.integration.spec.ts and subscription-sync.service.integration.spec.ts.

The comment in entitlements.constants.ts was rewritten to list the keys the Business plan actually sends and to explain that the seed lags the plan. moisses89 replied "✅ Fixed, and it was wrong not aspirational".
moisses89 replied "❌ Left as is: checking existence first adds a round trip to the happy path". The Promise.all is unchanged at entitlements.service.ts:87.
A 'returns 403 without an access token' test was added to entitlements.controller.integration.spec.ts after e3a1ca7, following LucieFaire's suggestion.

spaceId was removed from UsageKey in space-feature-usage.repository.interface.ts (commit 1f4c4b0a3, "narrow UsageKey"), and periods is now `Array<UsageKey>` instead of `Omit<UsageKey,'spaceId'>`. The thread is resolved, and moisses89 said all of LucieFaire's comments were applied.
moisses89 replied "❌ Intentional: a feature that no longer exists has no entitlements. Documented in down()". The down() in migrations/1787148838500-seed-features.ts is the same as it was at e3a1ca7.
